pose_protocols.A: retained-frame human pose from training poses only (V10 SLERP/linear rule)
pose_protocols.B: retained-frame human pose and camera from the published release (HOSNeRF official test loader condition); query-only, never used for training, initialization, colour or selection

evaluator.lpips: AlexNet v0.1 spatial mean via evaluate_and_report.lpips_cpu (same as V10)
evaluator.ssim: 7x7 uniform window, sample covariance, full map mean

E3.question: How much of the V10 retained-frame foreground drop comes from training-pose interpolation?
E3.models: V10 frozen terminal checkpoints P and PQ (20000 fresh-Adam updates); C and PARENT take no pose input, so their protocol-B renders equal protocol A by construction
E3.change: only the support-bank bone transforms at the 16 retained frames (published SMPL instead of interpolation); base 4DGS, cameras, times unchanged
E3.decision: foreground gain >= 1 dB on a scene marks pose interpolation as a major error source under protocol A
